posts.title: The Race I Wasn’t Ready For (I Was Ready For)
posts.description: Three days before my first 10K in years, I caught a cold. The day before, I nearly phoned in sick from work, then thought better of bragging about a race I'd skipped the Friday before it. I ran it anyway, nearly gave up on a hill nobody warned me about, and finished in 1:06:05, faster than my own phone thought I'd gone.
